name: Swarm of Insects (Spiders)
classification: Medium swarm of Tiny Beasts, unaligned
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Blindsight 10 ft., passive Perception 8. No listed skills or languages. Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Immune to charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, and stunned.
appearance: A cluster of mottled brown spiders with bristled bodies and long jointed legs.

sections.Printed source:
Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual (2014), p. 338. Derive from Swarm of Insects and the Variant: Insect Swarms sidebar. https://online.anyflip.com/sqwmo/hxog/mobile/index.html#p=339
Monster Manual errata v2.0 (2018), p. 2. All swarms are immune to being grappled.
sections.Traits:
Swarm. Other creatures can share the swarm’s space. It can move through a gap large enough for a single Tiny insect. It cannot recover hit points or gain temporary hit points.
Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings while upside down, without an ability check.
Web Sense. While touching a web, the swarm knows exactly where other creatures touching the same web are.
Web Walker. Webbing does not restrict the swarm’s movement.
sections.Actions: Bites. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm’s space. A hit deals 10 (4d4) piercing damage. At half the swarm’s maximum hit points or fewer, a hit deals 5 (2d4) piercing damage instead.
sections.At the table: With the printed 22 maximum HP, Bites uses the lower damage at 11 HP or fewer. Both swarm variants deal piercing damage. There is no added poison damage, save, or poisoned condition.
